tagline: User review for permanent message deletion through mcp-mail-server.
summary: Opt-in HOL Guard coverage for mcp-mail-server. After local-admin enablement, delete_message and delete_messages require review. Mailbox listing and search can receive automatic allow defaults only when the reviewed launch identity matches. Other tools inherit host handling, while this-device custom grants and stronger Guard policy constraints retain their existing priority.
limitations: Coverage focuses on permanent deletion through delete_message and delete_messages; other mail mutations retain host policy.
Automatic read allowances require the reviewed npx launcher, stdio transport, registry package selectors and default package-source evidence without configured package-manager overrides.
Default package-source evidence does not attest to installed code or the contents of ambient package-manager configuration files.
A publisher profile is not a security certification or an endorsement by HOL.
